chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: 1. Describe the key functions and sources of revenue of an Urban Local Body.
back_answer:
Point-wise Answer:
1. Sanitation & Health: Waste collection, street sweeping, sewage maintenance, disease control.
2. Infrastructure: Clean drinking water supply, street lighting, road repairs, maintenance of public parks.
3. Civic Documentation: Official registration of births and deaths.
4. Internal Tax Revenue: Property tax, water tax, trade license fees, entertainment tax.
5. Government Grants: Financial grants allocated by State and Central Governments for major urban projects.
